{{Quote|So you have the coordinates for the Nexus Route?''"<br />"''I got them, all right. Half of them, anyway. My captain's got the other half. I erased the computers when we were boarded and had both of us memorize part of the intel. That way, if somehow I cracked, the information would be useless to them without the other half.|Anakin Skywalker and Even Piell|<ref name="The Citadel" />}}
In the [[20 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] and the crew of his [[Even Piell's cruiser/Legends|Star Destroyer]] were '''captured''' by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After discovering the coordinates of the strategic [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]], Piell's forces were returning from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] when they came under [[Space warfare/Legends|attack]] by a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. With their heavily damaged [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] boarded by Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], Piell, [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] personnel were taken into custody by the Separatists, who sought to pilfer Piell's findings on the Nexus Route. Unwilling to let Piell's Nexus Route intelligence fall into enemy hands, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] subsequently launched a [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|mission]] to rescue Piell from [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisonment]] in the highly secured [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] before the Separatists could extract the valuable information from him.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|He obtained the coordinates of a secret hyperspace lane known as the Nexus Route which travels into the heart of both the Republic and Separatist homeworlds.|Plo Koon, on Even Piell|<ref name="The Citadel" />}}
[[File:EvenPiellCloseUp-TC.png|thumb|left|240px|Even Piell was responsible for unearthing the coordinates of the Nexus Route.]]
As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] raged across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and [[Spy/Legends|spies]] on both sides of the conflict worked to find new [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|navigation routes]] that would give their respective [[Army/Legends|military]] an advantage in the war.<ref name="TCW Incredible Vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> Such was the case<ref name="The Citadel" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="The Citadel Date" /> when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] took a [[Squad/Legends|detachment]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on a perilous assignment in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. There, Piell and his [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], obtained the coordinates of the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]], a strategic hyperlane that connected the Republic and Confederate [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] and was thus of immense value to both [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] powers. However, the Confederacy caught wind of Piell's discovery and launched a campaign to [[Prisoner/Legends|capture]] him and extract his findings on the Nexus Route.<ref name="The Citadel" />

==The capture==
[[File:PiellCruiser-Attack.png|thumb|right|250px|Outclassed in strength, Piell's cruiser falls under attack from the Separatist fleet.]]
While returning from the Outer Rim aboard their [[Even Piell's cruiser/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] Piell's forces were [[Space warfare/Legends|assaulted]] by a [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] comprising a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] and a pair of [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. Directing [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]] at Piell's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the Confederate [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] launched [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] to assail the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. Piell's crew returned [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] fire at one of the Separatist [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], but the enemy [[Warship/Legends|warships]] deployed [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to board the embattled Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] before Piell and Tarkin even had [[Time/Legends|time]] to launch [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|counter]] the enemy [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]]. As the Separatist boarding party infiltrated the Republic cruiser, Piell erased his [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] records to safeguard the Nexus Route intelligence, and he and Tarkin each memorized half of the information so that it would be harder for the Separatists to secure the data.<ref name="The Citadel" />

Shortly thereafter, [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]&mdash;which had cut a path through the Star Destroyer's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] defenses&mdash;arrived on the cruiser's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]], where Piell and several of his [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officers]] were monitoring the battle. Although Piell swiftly decimated the incoming [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Telekinesis/Legends|push]], the arrival of [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] forced him and his crew to stand down to the Confederate forces.<ref name="The Citadel" />

==Aftermath==
{{Dialogue|Obi-Wan Kenobi|Master Piell, are you all right?|Even Piell|Obi-Wan. What took you guys so long?|Anakin Skywalker|At least your sense of humor is still intact.|Even Piell|It takes more than they got to break me, young Skywalker.|attr=Even Piell is rescued by Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|src=<ref name="The Citadel" />}}
[[File:PiellRescued-TC.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker and Kenobi infiltrate the Citadel to rescue Piell from Separatist interrogation.]]
Their cruiser captured by the Separatists,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Piell">{{SWE|characters|evenpiell|Even Piell}}</ref> Piell, Tarkin, and five of their clone [[Troop/Legends|trooper]] crew were incarcerated in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]], a deadly [[Prison/Legends|detention center]] that had originally been designed for the confinement of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] and had since been put to use by the Separatists. The Citadel's [[Warden/Legends|warden]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]], [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] Piell in an effort to force him into surrendering the Nexus Route intelligence. After learning of Piell's incarceration, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] commissioned a team to free Piell from the Citadel, with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] devising a strategy to infiltrate the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress's]] stringent outer security. Once a plan had been agreed upon, Kenobi and Skywalker&mdash;with the unauthorized addition of the latter's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]&mdash;led an elite team of clone troopers to break into the Separatist prison and save Piell.<ref name="The Citadel" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Returning from a perilous assignment in the Outer Rim, Jedi Master Even Piell's cruiser has fallen under attack and been boarded. Seeking vital information he carries about secret hyperspace lanes called the Nexus Route, Separatist forces have taken him alive.|The Newsreel for "The Citadel" introduces the battle|<ref name="The Citadel" />}}
The [[Realspace/Legends|space]] engagement featuring the capture of Even Piell was developed as a lead-in to "[[The Citadel (episode)|The Citadel]]," the eighteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]]. "The Citadel" premiered on [[February 18]], [[2011]] and featured the series' debut of Jedi Master Even Piell, a character first created for the [[1999]] [[Prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. Beyond being featured in the episode's brief "Newsreel" opening,<ref name="The Citadel Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode318.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Citadel}}</ref> the battle did not receive any further appearances beyond mentions in various source material that accompanied the episode.<ref name="UK Comic 6.18">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.18|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.18]]</ref><ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Because of a lack of information presented in the episode,<ref name="The Citadel" /> a specific location for the battle cannot be determined.
